hints.title: Running Ascending Sum
hints.text: Maintain the current sum of the ascending streak starting from nums[0].

hints.title: Check Strict Increase
hints.text: If nums[i] > nums[i - 1], add nums[i] to current sum; otherwise reset current sum to nums[i].

hints.title: Track Peak Sum
hints.text: Update global maximum sum after evaluating each element.

hints.title: Full Implementation

complexity.whyNaiveFails: No naive bottleneck exists; linear scan is optimal.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Constant space single pass tracks current ascending sum and peak.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate writes clean single loop resetting sum on non-increasing transitions.
